title: MeasurementDefinitionRegistry
description: Body measurement definitions (planning/07 §3.3; owner decision 2026-10-13): each measurement id names its unit dimension, its stored (canonical) unit and its hard bounds. Both bounds are inclusive: a value equal to a bound is accepted. A value outside them is refused and never stored, never clamped (doc 07 §3.3 severity 1). No conditional range is registered. Ids are stable: never rename or reuse one. packages/shared-kernel/tests also check what a schema cannot express: min < max and unit equals the dimension's canonical unit in units.json.

measurements.description: Measurement id (snake_case, the wire key) to its definition

unit.description: Stored unit: the dimension's canonical unit (cm for length, kg for mass)

min.description: Smallest accepted value, inclusive, in unit

max.description: Largest accepted value, inclusive, in unit
